title: Publishable item sidecar
description: The JSON sidecar beside each item a producer offers through publishable-output 1.0 (owned by the publishing module). tlp is the producer's CLAIM: the gate excludes red and amber, re-derives the marking from the content (a TLP marker or a deny-listed name in the body blocks it) and scans everything before it leaves the lab. Only inert media types are accepted: the gate renders HTML itself, so no producer ships markup or script.
